title: Embedded Systems Intern (Hardware + IoT) - Chennai
description: We are looking for a passionate Embedded Systems Intern to work on real hardware, IoT products, and live projects. The ideal candidate is an EEE / ECE / Mechatronics student or recent graduate with a basic understanding of electronics, microcontrollers, and Embedded C/C++. You should enjoy hands-on work such as building circuits, testing boards, debugging hardware, and learning how a product moves from idea to prototype. Experience in college, mini, or DIY projects using ESP32, STM32, Arduino, or Raspberry Pi will be an added advantage . We are looking for someone eager to learn, takes ownership, and aims to grow as an Embedded Hardware Engineer . Internship Duration & Stipend Total Duration: 6 Months First 3 Months: Training / Trainee Period – No Stipend Next 3 Months: Paid Internship – ₹5,000 per month Continuation and future opportunities may be based on the candidate’s performance and organizational requirements . Key Responsibilities Assist in the design and development of embedded hardware systems and electronic circuits. Work with microcontrollers such as ESP32, STM32, Arduino, and Raspberry Pi. Develop and test firmware using Embedded C/C++.Support PCB schematic design, layout review, and prototype bring-up. Interface sensors, actuators, communication modules, and power systems. Perform hardware debugging, testing, and validation using multimeters, oscilloscopes, and other test equipment. Prepare technical documentation, test reports, and design records.Assist in IoT product development, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, UART, SPI, and I2C protocols. Collaborate with mechanical, software, and product development teams. Required SkillsBasic knowledge of electronics, digital circuits, and embedded systems. Familiarity with Embedded C/C++ programming.Understanding of microcontrollers and communication protocols. Knowledge of circuit debugging using multimeters, oscilloscopes, and other test equipment.Exposure to PCB design tools such as KiCad, Altium, EasyEDA, or Eagle is an advantage. Interest in IoT, automation, robotics, or product development. Eligibility to apply BE / B.Tech students or recent graduates in EEE, ECE, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or Instrumentation Engineering. Freshers are welcome to apply What You Will Get Hands-on experience on live IoT and embedded products Mentorship from experienced engineers Internship Certificate Performance-based PPO opportunity Pay: ₹5,000.00 per month Work Location: In person

If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! Job Description The Facility Apprentice will support the Facilities team in maintaining building infrastructure, utilities, HVAC systems, electrical systems, safety equipment, and general facility operations. This role provides hands-on training and practical exposure to facility management practices, preventive maintenance activities, contractor coordination, and statutory compliance requirements.
